title: Eventual vanishing of a homomorphism zero on an open complement
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian quasi-compact scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], I a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, F a quasi-coherent module, and G a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent]. Write j_n:I^n G -> G for the image-defined inclusion [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. Let U be an open consisting exactly of points where I_x -> O_X,x is surjective. If chi:I^n G -> F restricts to zero on U [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], then there exist m >= n such that every r:I^m G -> I^n G satisfying r followed by j_n equal to j_m has r followed by chi equal to zero. This asserts only eventual vanishing, not extension or existence of the transition maps.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YB (lemma-homs-over-open), omitted injectivity, expanded with Lemma 01Y9

proof.text: Quasi-coherence of powers and their products follows from the affine ideal-product formulas. I^n G is a quasi-coherent submodule of coherent G, hence coherent on the locally Noetherian scheme.

The image Q of chi is quasi-coherent, with affine section modules equal to images of the affine section maps. Those modules are finitely generated as images of the finite section modules of I^n G. The affine finite-type criterion and coherence criterion imply that Q is coherent. The zero restriction of chi implies zero image on U, hence zero stalks of Q at points of U. Using hU, its nonzero-stalk locus is contained in the nonsurjective-stalk locus of I.

The support-power-ideal lemma gives t with I^t Q=0. Set m=n+t. On each affine W the image of j_m is I(W)^t I(W)^n G(W). Any factor r through the monomorphic j_n identifies this with I(W)^t times the sections of I^n G; linearity shows that chi sends it to I(W)^t Q(W)=0. Thus r followed by chi vanishes on every affine open. Sheaf separatedness over the affine basis makes it zero globally. The same exponent works for every r, since the factor through j_n is unique.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_hom_ideal_power_eventually_zero {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [CompactSpace X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F G : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U ↔ Function.Surjective
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map I.toModulesι).hom)
    (n : ℕ) (χ : idealModuleProduct (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2 G ⟶ F)
    (hχ : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map χ = 0) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (_ : n ≤ m),
      ∀ r : idealModuleProduct (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2 G ⟶
          idealModuleProduct (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2 G,
        r ≫ idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2 G =
          idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2 G → r ≫ χ = 0
